component.name: pgvector
component.title: PGVector
component.description: Store, delete and search vector embeddings in a PostgreSQL table with the pgvector extension.
component.label: database,ai

action.label: producer
action.description: The action to perform. The CamelPgVectorAction header, when set, wins over this option.

configuration.description: The configuration shared by the endpoints of the component. Each endpoint uses a copy of it, which its own options then change.

dataSource.description: The javax.sql.DataSource of the PostgreSQL database. The endpoint fails to start when no DataSource is set or autowired. The producer takes a new connection from it for each message, so a pooling DataSource is recommended.

dimension.label: producer
dimension.description: The number of dimensions of the embedding column that CREATE_TABLE creates, as vector(n). It must match the size of the vectors of the embedding model, as PostgreSQL rejects a vector of another size. The other actions do not use it.

distanceType.label: producer
distanceType.description: The distance function of SIMILARITY_SEARCH and of the HNSW index that CREATE_INDEX creates: COSINE (cosine distance), EUCLIDEAN (L2 distance) or INNER_PRODUCT (the negative inner product, so the closest records have the lowest distance). A search uses the index only when both use the same distance type.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

CamelPgVectorAction.description: The action that the producer performs. It replaces the action option.

CamelPgVectorRecordId.description: The id of the record, of at most 36 characters. UPSERT inserts the record with this id or replaces it, and uses a random UUID when the header is not set. DELETE requires it.

CamelPgVectorQueryTopK.description: The maximum number of results to return for similarity search.

CamelPgVectorTextContent.description: The text that UPSERT stores in the text_content column of the record.

CamelPgVectorMetadata.description: The metadata that UPSERT stores in the metadata column of the record, a TEXT column. The producer does not check the value; the pgvector:embeddings transformer sets it as a JSON object.

CamelPgVectorFilter.description: Filter condition for similarity search. Applied as a SQL WHERE clause on the text_content and metadata columns. Supports parameterized queries using ? placeholders with values provided via the CamelPgVectorFilterParams header. WARNING: When not using parameterized queries, the filter value is appended directly as SQL. Never use untrusted input as the filter value without parameterization, as this could lead to SQL injection.

CamelPgVectorFilterParams.description: The values of the ? placeholders of the CamelPgVectorFilter header, in order. For example the filter text_content LIKE ? AND metadata::jsonb->>'category' = ? with the List [%hello%, science]. The producer reads it only when that header is set.

producerIn.description: By the action in the action option or the CamelPgVectorAction header: the vector as a List of numbers, such as the List of Double a JSON array unmarshals to, or a float or double array for UPSERT and SIMILARITY_SEARCH, with the id, text and metadata of UPSERT in headers. CREATE_TABLE, CREATE_INDEX, DROP_TABLE and DELETE do not read the body, DELETE takes the id from the CamelPgVectorRecordId header. Another body fails: the pgvector:embeddings data type transformer builds the vector from the output of langchain4j-embeddings

producerOut.description: By the action: a Boolean for CREATE_TABLE, CREATE_INDEX, DROP_TABLE and DELETE (false when no record had the id), the record id as a String for UPSERT, and a List of Map with the keys id, text_content, metadata and distance for SIMILARITY_SEARCH

collection.description: The name of the table that holds the records. It must be a plain SQL identifier of letters, digits and underscores that does not start with a digit. CREATE_INDEX names the index after the table, followed by _embedding_idx.
